name: Edwall-innspill
source: designed from the NTHF text (no puck.no picture); PROPOSED, for the user's review
text: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and sends it in to the center
note: User review 2026-10-14: the wing starts further back in its slot, faces forward, puck between the blade heel and the skate (heel groove). User review 2026-11-27 (Lindahl-innspill, applied to every centre that takes a pass from the right wing): the centre receives with its back to the right wing, which gives the most area to catch the puck. User review 2026-11-27 (Edwall-innspill, applied to every heel-groove carry): in the heel groove the figure is turned with the stick about 45 deg toward the right boards, the puck touching only the skate and the stick heel (never through the stick).
